MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The powered USB hub fits my history of adding computer connections through a USB expansion card and network adapters.",
    "External power and individual port switches make the hub useful for managing accessories, although ten ports may exceed my needs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming devices and Alexa speakers do not solve the computer connectivity needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "An HDMI cable is not interchangeable with the DVI cable I previously needed; the connection must fit my equipment.",
    "Memory cards and a USB reader serve a storage need I have not identified. Having a USB connection alone does not make them useful to me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in computer accessories seems to have been stretched into an interest in electronics generally, including home entertainment devices.",
    "My headset purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to recommend speakers, even though those serve different purposes for me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases suggest specific, occasional needs for connecting existing equipment, rather than a continuing desire to buy gadgets.",
    "The exact function and connector matter: expanding USB ports, adding Ethernet, and connecting a DVI display address different needs.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear use for it, so a related accessory still needs to solve a current problem."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The USB hub fits my practical connectivity interests, but most suggestions turn those specific needs into a broad interest in entertainment electronics."
}
